name.description: Player-facing name. British spelling. Must pass legal sweep.

speed.description: Hundredths of a cell per tick, integer-encoded (18 => 0.18)

air.description: ADR-028 clause 1: whether this unit flies. A property of the TYPE and never per-entity state, which is what keeps it free of the state hash. An air unit steps straight towards its target, ignores terrain and separation, and can be engaged only by a weapon that declares anti-air (clause 3, an equality in both directions: a ground weapon cannot reach it and an anti-air weapon cannot shoot the ground). Authored since ADR-028 and read by DataLoader ever since; this schema simply had not been told.

produced_at.description: Structure id of the building that produces this unit. The producer IS a prerequisite; do not repeat it in the prerequisites list.

max_alive.description: P7-11b: how many LIVING units of this type one player may own at once. 0 means unlimited, which is what every unit written before the heroes means, so the enforcement is a complete no-op for them and the golden hashes do not move. A cap is checked where the unit is QUEUED and again where production COMPLETES: the queue check alone would let a player order two while owning none, and the completion check alone would let the sidebar accept an order the sim then refuses. A capped unit whose completion is blocked HOLDS at full progress, fully paid, exactly as one whose spawn cells are all occupied does, so the credits are never lost and the unit arrives the moment the standing one dies.
